preconditions.description: The dimensions of the room must be between 1 and 50.
At least one of the dimensions n or m must be even.

preconditions.expression: len(current_config) == n and all(len(row) == m for row in current_config)
preconditions.description: The current configuration must have n rows, each with m characters.

preconditions.expression: len(desired_config) == n and all(len(row) == m for row in desired_config)
preconditions.description: The desired configuration must have n rows, each with m characters.

postconditions.expression: stdout == '-1' if not possible else True
postconditions.description: If it is impossible to achieve the desired configuration, output -1.
The number of operations must not exceed 100,000.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= row <= n and 1 <= col <= m for row, col in operations)
postconditions.description: All operation coordinates must be within the bounds of the room.
